248   		cwd: ctx.cwd,
249   		agentDir,
250   		authStorage: ctx.modelRegistry.authStorage,
251   		modelRegistry: ctx.modelRegistry,
252   		settingsManager,
253   		resourceLoaderOptions: forwarded.resourceLoaderOptions,
254   	});
255   	const childModel = services.modelRegistry.find(model.provider, model.id) ?? model;
256   	const { session } = await createAgentSessionFromServices({
257   		services,
258   		sessionManager: SessionManager.inMemory(ctx.cwd),
259   		model: childModel,
260   		thinkingLevel,
261   		tools: forwarded.tools,
262   		excludeTools: forwarded.excludeTools,
263   		noTools: forwarded.noTools,
264   	});
265   
266   	runningAgent.session = session;
267   	runningAgent.status = "running";
268   	logSteering(runningAgent.id, "session-created", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
269   	if (runningAgent.aborted) void session.abort();
270   	widget.update();
271   
272   	await session.bindExtensions({ mode: "print" });
273   	logSteering(runningAgent.id, "session-bound", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
274   	if (inheritedMessages.length > 0) {
275   		session.agent.state.messages = inheritedMessages;
276   		runningAgent.inheritedMessageCount = inheritedMessages.length;
277   		logSteering(runningAgent.id, "context-inherited", { messageCount: inheritedMessages.length });
278   	}
279   
280   	const unsubscribe = subscribeToChildSession(session, runningAgent, widget);
281   	try {
282   		logSteering(runningAgent.id, "initial-prompt-started", { streaming: session.isStreaming, taskLength: task.length });
283   		await session.prompt(task);
284   		logSteering(runningAgent.id, "initial-prompt-settled", { streaming: session.isStreaming, messageCount: session.agent.state.messages.length });
285   		return getFinalAssistantText(session);
286   	} finally {
287   		unsubscribe();
288   		logSteering(runningAgent.id, "session-shutdown", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
289   		await session.extensionRunner.emit({ type: "session_shutdown", reason: "quit" });

293   function subscribeToChildSession(session: AgentSession, runningAgent: RunningAgent, widget: UserAgentWidget): () => void {
294   	return session.subscribe((event: AgentSessionEvent) => {
295   		if (event.type === "agent_start") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "child-agent-started", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
296   		if (event.type === "agent_end") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "child-agent-ended", { streaming: session.isStreaming, messageCount: event.messages.length });
297   		if (event.type === "agent_settled") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "child-agent-settled", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
298   		if (event.type === "turn_start") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "turn-started", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
299   		if (event.type === "turn_end") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "turn-ended", { streaming: session.isStreaming });
300   		if (event.type === "message_start") logSteering(runningAgent.id, "message-started", { role: event.message.role, streaming: session.isStreaming });
301   		const finalizedMessageUpdate = event.type === "message_update" && event.assistantMessageEvent.type.endsWith("_end");
302   		if (finalizedMessageUpdate || event.type === "message_end") runningAgent.latestFinalizedMessage = structuredClone(event.message);
303   		if (finalizedMessageUpdate && event.message.role === "assistant" && event.assistantMessageEvent.type === "text_end") {
304   			runningAgent.responseText = assistantText(event.message);
305   		}
306   		if (event.type === "message_end" && event.message.role === "assistant") runningAgent.responseText = assistantText(event.message);
307   		if (event.type === "tool_execution_start") {
308   			runningAgent.activeTools.set(event.toolCallId, event.toolName);
309   		}
310   		if (event.type === "tool_execution_end") {
311   			runningAgent.activeTools.delete(event.toolCallId);
312   			runningAgent.toolUses += 1;
313   		}
314   		if (event.type === "turn_end") {
315   			runningAgent.turnCount += 1;
316   		}
317   		if (event.type === "message_update" && !finalizedMessageUpdate) return;
318   		widget.update();
319   	});
320   }
321   
322   function assistantText(message: Extract<AgentMessage, { role: "assistant" }>): string {
323   	return message.content
324   		.filter((part) => part.type === "text")
325   		.map((part) => part.text)
326   		.join("\n");
327   }
328   
329   function getFinalAssistantText(session: AgentSession): string {
330   	const assistantMessages = session.agent.state.messages.filter((message) => message.role === "assistant");
331   	const lastMessage = assistantMessages.at(-1);
332   	if (!lastMessage) throw new Error("User agent finished without an assistant message");
333   	if (lastMessage.stopReason === "error" || lastMessage.stopReason === "aborted") {
334   		throw new Error(lastMessage.errorMessage ?? `User agent ${lastMessage.stopReason}`);
335   	}
336   
337   	const text = assistantText(lastMessage).trim();
338   	if (!text) throw new Error("User agent returned no text response");
339   	return text;
340   }

"""Compare the Rust `markdown-it` crate's parse against `markdown-it-py`'s.

The first mate's condition on adopting the crate: two ports of one reference can
drift by version, and the whole argument for a crate over a hand-written parser is
that the drift is **measurable**. This measures it.

Both sides emit the *flattened* token stream `rich.markdown` actually consumes —
`_flatten_tokens` drops the `inline` wrapper and yields its children, except for
`image` and `fence` — because that stream, not the parser's internal shape, is what
decides a rendered byte.

Fields compared are the ones Rich reads: `type`, `tag`, `content`, `info`, and the
attributes it looks up (`href` on a link, `start` on an ordered list, `src`/`title`
on an image). `nesting` is implied by the type suffix and is not compared twice.

import collections
import re
import json
import os
import random
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

# TEXT part to Markdown, so `<SOURCE>` never reaches the parser as markup on that
# path. Copied from there rather than approximated, because the exposure of any
# HTML-shaped parser divergence depends on exactly which inputs survive it.
XML_TAG_PATTERN = re.compile(r"<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*[>\s]")


def escape_tag_like(text: str) -> str:
    if XML_TAG_PATTERN.search(text):
        return re.sub(r"<(/?)([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*)(\s+[^>]*?)?>", r"\\<\1\2\3>", text)
    return text


def comparable_content(kind: str, content: str) -> str:
    """The part of a token's content that reaches a rendered byte.

    An `html_block`'s content reaches `UnknownElement`, whose `on_text` is a no-op
    and whose render yields nothing. A fence's or an indented block's reaches
    `CodeBlock.__rich_console__`, which does `str(self.text).rstrip()` before
    handing it to `Syntax`. Both are read from the Rich source, not assumed.
    """
    if kind == "html_block":
        return ""
    if kind in ("fence", "code_block"):
        return content.rstrip()
    return content


def flatten(tokens):
    """`rich.markdown.Markdown._flatten_tokens`, copied so the comparison uses it."""
    for token in tokens:
        is_fence = token.type == "fence"
        is_image = token.tag == "img"
        if token.children and not (is_image or is_fence):
            yield from flatten(token.children)
        else:
            yield token

    records = []

            # comparison is over what renders rather than over token bookkeeping.

import os

import pytest

import chats.commands.search as search_commands
from chats.commands.search import (
    _file_contains_ascii,
    _file_contains_ascii_json_strings,
)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("content", "needle", "case_sensitive", "evidence_groups", "expected"),
    [
        pytest.param(b"prefix Exact suffix", b"Exact", True, (), True, id="exact"),
        pytest.param(b"prefix Exact suffix", b"exact", True, (), False, id="case-sensitive-miss"),
        pytest.param(b"prefix EXACT suffix", b"exact", False, (), True, id="ascii-lowercase"),
        pytest.param("unrelated café".encode(), b"absent", True, (), False, id="valid-unicode"),
        pytest.param(
            "unrelated café".encode(),
            b"absent",
            False,
            (),
            False,
            id="safe-unicode-continues",
        ),
        pytest.param(b"unrelated \xff bytes", b"absent", True, (), True, id="invalid-utf8"),
        pytest.param(b"unrelated \xff bytes", b"absent", False, (), True, id="invalid-utf8-insensitive"),
        pytest.param(b"incomplete \xf0\x9f\x98", b"absent", True, (), True, id="incomplete-utf8"),
        pytest.param(
            b"incomplete \xf0\x9f\x98",
            b"absent",
            False,
            (),
            True,
            id="incomplete-utf8-insensitive",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            b"first marker and later second marker",
            b"absent",
            True,
            ((b"first", b"second"),),
            True,
            id="complete-evidence-group",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            b"first marker only",
            b"absent",
            True,
            ((b"first", b"second"),),
            False,
            id="incomplete-evidence-group",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            b"UPPERCASE EVIDENCE",
            b"absent",
            False,
            ((b"uppercase", b"evidence"),),
            False,
            id="evidence-remains-exact",
        ),
        pytest.param(
            b"alternate marker",
            b"absent",
            True,
            ((b"missing",), (b"alternate",)),
            True,
            id="any-complete-evidence-group",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_native_ascii_candidate_scan_contract(
    tmp_path: Path,
    content: bytes,
    needle: bytes,
    case_sensitive: bool,
    evidence_groups: tuple[tuple[bytes, ...], ...],
    expected: bool,
) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "candidate.bin"
    path.write_bytes(content)

    actual = _file_contains_ascii(
        path,
        needle,
        case_sensitive=case_sensitive,
        evidence_groups=evidence_groups,
    )

    assert actual is expected, (
        "Expected the native ASCII candidate scan to preserve the locked contract. "
        f"Got: {actual=!r}, {expected=!r}, {case_sensitive=!r}, "
        f"{needle=!r}, {evidence_groups=!r}"
    )


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "content",
    [
        pytest.param(b'{"content":"CLIENT_ID/CARD"}\n', id="raw-solidus"),
        pytest.param(b'{"content":"CLIENT_ID\\/CARD"}\n', id="short-escaped-solidus"),
        pytest.param(b'{"content":"CLIENT_ID\\u002fCARD"}\n', id="unicode-escaped-solidus"),
        pytest.param(
            b'{"content":"CL\\u0049ENT_ID\\u002fCA\\u0052D"}\n',
            id="mixed-query-character-escapes",
        ),
    ],
)
def test_logical_json_string_scan_matches_raw_and_escaped_characters(
    tmp_path: Path,
    content: bytes,
) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "logical-match.jsonl"
    path.write_bytes(content)

    actual = _file_contains_ascii_json_strings(path, b"client_id/card")

    assert actual is True, (
        "Expected raw and escaped query characters to form one logical JSON "
        f"string match. Got: {actual=!r}, {content=!r}"
    )


def test_logical_json_string_batch_returns_decisions_in_input_order(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    paths = [tmp_path / f"candidate-{index}.jsonl" for index in range(4)]
    contents = [
        b'{"content":"CLIENT_ID/CARD"}\n',
        b'{"content":"unrelated text"}\n',
        b'{"content":"CLIENT_ID\\u002fCARD"}\n',
        b'{"content":"invalid \xff bytes"}\n',
    ]
    for path, content in zip(paths, contents, strict=True):
        path.write_bytes(content)

    actual = search_commands._files_contain_ascii_json_strings(
        paths,
        b"client_id/card",
        pi_sessions=[False, False, False, False],
    )

    assert actual == [True, False, True, True], (
        "Expected one native batch decision per input path in input order, with "
        f"encoding uncertainty preserved as a survivor. Got: {actual=!r}"
    )

    paths = [tmp_path / f"pi-evidence-{index}.jsonl" for index in range(3)]
    contents = [
        b'{"customType":"not-pi-user-agents"}\n',
        b'{"customType":"pi-user-agents"}\n',
        b'{"customType":"pi-user-agents"}\n',
    ]
    for path, content in zip(paths, contents, strict=True):

    actual = search_commands._files_contain_ascii_json_strings(
        paths,
        b"absent-query",
        pi_sessions=[True, True, False],
    )

        "Expected the exact joined-Pi marker to defer only its aligned Pi path. "
        f"Got: {actual=!r}"
    )

"""Behavior tests for boolean `AND`/`OR`/`NOT` operators in search patterns."""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from chats import ConversationFlags, SearchOutputMode, commands


def _write_session(
    path: Path,
    message_texts: list[str],
    *,
    summary: str | None = None,
    timestamp: str = "2025-01-01T00:00:00Z",
) -> None:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    lines: list[str] = []
    if summary is not None:
        lines.append(
            json.dumps({
                "type": "summary",
                "summary": summary,
                "leafUuid": f"{path.stem}-leaf",
            })
        )
    lines.extend(
        json.dumps({
            "type": "user",
            "timestamp": timestamp,
            "cwd": "/tmp/search-operators",
            "message": {"role": "user", "content": text},
        })
        for text in message_texts
    )
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def _claude_session_path(home: Path, stem: str) -> Path:
    return home / ".claude" / "projects" / "proj" / f"{stem}.jsonl"


def _run_search_ids(pattern: str, capsys) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
    """Run an only-id search and return (exit_code, matched session ids)."""
    with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as exc_info:
        commands.cmd_search(
            pattern,
            ConversationFlags(color="never", paging=False),
            output_mode=SearchOutputMode.ONLY_ID,
            emit_metadata=True,
        )
    stdout = capsys.readouterr().out
    return exc_info.value.code, stdout.split()


def test_and_requires_both_terms_in_same_session(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
    """`A AND B` matches sessions containing both terms, even in different messages."""
    home = tmp_path / "home"
    monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "home", lambda: home)

    _write_session(
        _claude_session_path(home, "has-both"),
        ["first message with opname-alpha", "second message with opname-bravo"],
    )
    _write_session(
        _claude_session_path(home, "has-alpha-only"),
        ["only opname-alpha appears here"],
    )

    exit_code, matched_ids = _run_search_ids("opname-alpha AND opname-bravo", capsys)

    assert exit_code == 0, (
        f"Expected `A AND B` search to find the session with both terms. Got exit code: {exit_code}"
    )
    assert "has-both" in matched_ids, (
        "Expected the session containing both terms (across different messages) to match. "
        f"Got matched ids: {matched_ids!r}"
    )
    assert "has-alpha-only" not in matched_ids, (
        "Expected the session containing only one of the `AND` terms not to match. "
        f"Got matched ids: {matched_ids!r}"
    )


def test_or_matches_sessions_with_either_term(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch, capsys) -> None:
    """`A OR B` matches sessions containing either term, and skips sessions with neither."""

        f"Got matched ids: {matched_ids!r}"
    )

        f"Expected sessions with neither term not to match. Got matched ids: {matched_ids!r}"
    )

    """Default search output for `A AND B` renders the messages matching each term."""

    )

    )

        f"Got stdout:\n{stdout}"

    _write_session(
        _claude_session_path(home, "bravo-and-charlie"),

    )

    exit_code, matched_ids = _run_search_ids(
        "opname-alpha AND (opname-bravo OR opname-charlie)", capsys
    )

    assert exit_code == 0, f"Expected the compound search to succeed. Got exit code: {exit_code}"

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

267	def _message_content_renderables(
268	    parts: list[MessagePart],
269	    highlight_regex: re.Pattern[str] | None,
270	    input_by_id: dict[str, dict] | None = None,
271	) -> list:
272	    """Render a message's visible parts (text, thinking, tools) to renderables.
273

275	    shared by the inline (search) and per-message-Panel (parse) views.
276	    """
277	    # Pattern to detect HTML/XML-like tags in content
278	    xml_tag_pattern = re.compile(r"<[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*[>\s]")
279	    out: list = []
280	    for part in parts:
281	        if out:
282	            out.append(Text(""))

284	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
285	            # Escape tag-like text so Markdown leaves it literal, not dropped
286	            if xml_tag_pattern.search(part.data):
287	                escaped_data = re.sub(
288	                    r"<(/?)([a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*)(\s+[^>]*?)?>",
289	                    r"\\<\1\2\3>",
290	                    part.data,
291	                )
292	                out.append(_text_renderable(escaped_data, highlight_regex))
293	            else:
294	                out.append(_text_renderable(part.data, highlight_regex))
295	
296	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
297	            out.append(Text("✻ thinking", style="message.meta"))
298	            out.append(LeftRail(Text(part.data, style="dim italic"), "message.meta"))
299	
300	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
301	            out.append(Text("✻ subagent task", style="message.meta"))
302	            out.append(LeftRail(Text(part.data, style="italic"), "message.meta"))
303	
304	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
305	            out.extend(render_tool_rich(part.data, input_by_id))

356	def render_message_inner_xml(
357	    msg: Message, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
358	) -> str:
359	    """Render message inner content (text, thinking, tools) to XML string.
360	
361	    Iterates msg.iter_visible_parts(flags), formats each part.
362	    Does NOT include outer wrapper tag or header.
363	    """
364	    output_parts: list[str] = []
365	    tool_parts: list[str] = []
366	
367	    def flush_tools() -> None:
368	        nonlocal tool_parts
369	        if tool_parts:
370	            output_parts.append("\n".join(tool_parts))
371	            tool_parts = []
372	
373	    for part in msg.iter_visible_parts(flags, tool_id_map):
374	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
375	            flush_tools()
376	            output_parts.append(part.data)
377	
378	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
382	
383	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
384	            flush_tools()
385	            tag = ContentBlockType.SUBAGENT_TASK.value.xml_tag
386	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
387	
388	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
389	            tool_parts.append(render_tool_xml(part.data))
390	
391	    flush_tools()
392	
393	    return "\n\n".join(output_parts)

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

356	def render_message_inner_xml(
357	    msg: Message, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
358	) -> str:
359	    """Render message inner content (text, thinking, tools) to XML string.
360	
361	    Iterates msg.iter_visible_parts(flags), formats each part.
362	    Does NOT include outer wrapper tag or header.
363	    """
364	    output_parts: list[str] = []
365	    tool_parts: list[str] = []
366	
367	    def flush_tools() -> None:
368	        nonlocal tool_parts
369	        if tool_parts:
370	            output_parts.append("\n".join(tool_parts))
371	            tool_parts = []
372	
373	    for part in msg.iter_visible_parts(flags, tool_id_map):
374	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
375	            flush_tools()
376	            output_parts.append(part.data)
377	
378	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
382	
383	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
384	            flush_tools()
385	            tag = ContentBlockType.SUBAGENT_TASK.value.xml_tag
386	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
387	
388	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
389	            tool_parts.append(render_tool_xml(part.data))
390	
391	    flush_tools()
392	
393	    return "\n\n".join(output_parts)

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

356	def render_message_inner_xml(
357	    msg: Message, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
358	) -> str:
359	    """Render message inner content (text, thinking, tools) to XML string.
360	
361	    Iterates msg.iter_visible_parts(flags), formats each part.
362	    Does NOT include outer wrapper tag or header.
363	    """
364	    output_parts: list[str] = []
365	    tool_parts: list[str] = []
366	
367	    def flush_tools() -> None:
368	        nonlocal tool_parts
369	        if tool_parts:
370	            output_parts.append("\n".join(tool_parts))
371	            tool_parts = []
372	
373	    for part in msg.iter_visible_parts(flags, tool_id_map):
374	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
375	            flush_tools()
376	            output_parts.append(part.data)
377	
378	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
382	
383	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
384	            flush_tools()
385	            tag = ContentBlockType.SUBAGENT_TASK.value.xml_tag
386	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
387	
388	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
389	            tool_parts.append(render_tool_xml(part.data))
390	
391	    flush_tools()
392	
393	    return "\n\n".join(output_parts)

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)

    parse: lead the rich view with a white session title
    
    The colored parse view opened with the same dim YAML frontmatter as the
    piping path. Replace it, in the color path only, with a left-aligned white
    title carrying the session name (when one exists), id, and created/modified
    dates — a heading above the role-colored panels, not another block. The plain
    (--color never) path keeps its full YAML frontmatter for machine consumption.
    
    build_session_title builds the title Text; cmd_parse stashes it and prints it
    inside the pager context, so it shares the same buffered output as the panels
    instead of flashing on the main screen before less takes the alternate screen
    (paging defaults to color, so the interactive default pages).
    
    Covered by tests pinning the title's placement above the first panel, the
    no-custom-title id headline, and that the title lands in the paged buffer.
    The structured-rendering shell test that asserted a '---' separator (only ever
    the frontmatter's) now verifies the title header instead.

    Redesign message role colors around a coherent One Atom Dark palette
    
    The eight per-message role hues were ad-hoc Tailwind hexes clustered in
    the blue–purple range (user blue, recap dark-blue, assistant violet,
    compaction fuchsia), so roles were hard to tell apart. Introduce a single
    named palette in theme.py borrowed from One Atom Dark and assign one
    well-separated hue per role group: user blue, assistant magenta, agent
    cyan, recap green, compaction amber, session-rename red. The three user-*
    tags keep one shared blue since they are one actor.
    
    Role badge chips switch from white to dark ink text so they stay legible
    on the lighter pastel backgrounds. The message-body styles (tool.call,
    tool.error, diff.add, diff.remove) now reference the same palette, folding
    two near-identical reds into one.

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")

398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []

404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425

21	    """
22	    Parse a message timestamp into local time.
23	
24	    >>> _message_timestamp_datetime("2026-06-21T09:30:00").date().isoformat()
25	    '2026-06-21'
26	    >>> _message_timestamp_datetime(None) is None
27	    True

33	        return parsed
34	    return parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)

37	def _ordinal_day(day: int) -> str:
38	    """
39	    Render a calendar day with an English ordinal suffix.
40	
41	    >>> [_ordinal_day(day) for day in (1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 21)]
42	    ['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '11th', '12th', '13th', '21st']
43	    """
44	    if 10 <= day % 100 <= 20:
45	        return f"{day}th"
46	    suffix = {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(day % 10, "th")
47	    return f"{day}{suffix}"

216	    def iter_visible_parts(
217	        self, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
218	    ) -> list[MessagePart]:
219	        """Yield all visible content parts based on flags.
220	
221	        This is the single source of truth for:
222	        - What content is visible (flag-based filtering)
223	        - Content ordering (text, thinking, tools, plan)
224	        - Shortening (text/thinking/plan via shorten_data; tool bodies via truncate_middle)
225	
226	        Plans are represented as TOOL parts with name="ExitPlanMode".
227	        """
228	        parts: list[MessagePart] = []
229	
230	        # Subagent task prompt — always shown (it is what was handed to the agent).
231	        if self.subagent_task:
232	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK, self.subagent_task))
233	
234	        # Text content
235	        if self.text:
236	            text = (
237	                shorten_data(self.text, width=flags.shorten_width)
238	                if flags.shorten
239	                else self.text
240	            )
241	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.TEXT, text))
242	
243	        # Thinking block
244	        if flags.show_thinking and self.thinking:
245	            should_shorten_thinking = flags.shorten or flags.shorten_thinking
246	            thinking = (
247	                truncate_middle(self.thinking, max_len=flags.shorten_width)
248	                if should_shorten_thinking
249	                else self.thinking
250	            )
251	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.THINKING, thinking))
252	
253	        # Tools
254	        if flags.show_tools and self.tools:
255	            self._append_tool_parts(parts, flags, tool_id_map)
256	
257	        # Plan (as tool-like part with name="ExitPlanMode")
258	        if flags.show_plans and self.plan:
259	            plan_content = (
260	                shorten_data(self.plan, width=flags.shorten_width)
261	                if flags.shorten
262	                else self.plan
263	            )
264	            plan_parts = ToolParts(
265	                tag=ContentBlockType.TOOL_INPUT.value.xml_tag,
266	                attrs=[("name", "ExitPlanMode")],
267	                content=plan_content,
268	                is_empty=False,
269	            )
270	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.TOOL, plan_parts))
271	
272	        return parts

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

81	    return HighlightedMarkdown(markup, highlight_regex, "search.match")

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

356	def render_message_inner_xml(
357	    msg: Message, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
358	) -> str:
359	    """Render message inner content (text, thinking, tools) to XML string.
360	
361	    Iterates msg.iter_visible_parts(flags), formats each part.
362	    Does NOT include outer wrapper tag or header.
363	    """
364	    output_parts: list[str] = []
365	    tool_parts: list[str] = []
366	
367	    def flush_tools() -> None:
368	        nonlocal tool_parts
369	        if tool_parts:
370	            output_parts.append("\n".join(tool_parts))
371	            tool_parts = []
372	
373	    for part in msg.iter_visible_parts(flags, tool_id_map):
374	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
375	            flush_tools()
376	            output_parts.append(part.data)
377	
378	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
382	
383	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
384	            flush_tools()
385	            tag = ContentBlockType.SUBAGENT_TASK.value.xml_tag
386	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
387	
388	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
389	            tool_parts.append(render_tool_xml(part.data))
390	
391	    flush_tools()
392	
393	    return "\n\n".join(output_parts)

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)

20	def _message_timestamp_datetime(timestamp: str | None) -> datetime | None:
21	    """
22	    Parse a message timestamp into local time.
23	
24	    >>> _message_timestamp_datetime("2026-06-21T09:30:00").date().isoformat()
25	    '2026-06-21'
26	    >>> _message_timestamp_datetime(None) is None
27	    True
28	    """
29	    if timestamp is None:
30	        return None
31	    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(timestamp.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
32	    if parsed.tzinfo is None:
33	        return parsed
34	    return parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)

37	def _ordinal_day(day: int) -> str:
38	    """
39	    Render a calendar day with an English ordinal suffix.
40	
41	    >>> [_ordinal_day(day) for day in (1, 2, 3, 4, 11, 12, 13, 21)]
42	    ['1st', '2nd', '3rd', '4th', '11th', '12th', '13th', '21st']
43	    """
44	    if 10 <= day % 100 <= 20:
45	        return f"{day}th"
46	    suffix = {1: "st", 2: "nd", 3: "rd"}.get(day % 10, "th")
47	    return f"{day}{suffix}"

216	    def iter_visible_parts(
217	        self, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
218	    ) -> list[MessagePart]:
219	        """Yield all visible content parts based on flags.
220	
221	        This is the single source of truth for:
222	        - What content is visible (flag-based filtering)
223	        - Content ordering (text, thinking, tools, plan)
224	        - Shortening (text/thinking/plan via shorten_data; tool bodies via truncate_middle)
225	
226	        Plans are represented as TOOL parts with name="ExitPlanMode".
227	        """
228	        parts: list[MessagePart] = []
229	
230	        # Subagent task prompt — always shown (it is what was handed to the agent).
231	        if self.subagent_task:
232	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK, self.subagent_task))
233	
234	        # Text content
235	        if self.text:
236	            text = (
237	                shorten_data(self.text, width=flags.shorten_width)
238	                if flags.shorten
239	                else self.text
240	            )
241	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.TEXT, text))
242	
243	        # Thinking block
244	        if flags.show_thinking and self.thinking:
245	            should_shorten_thinking = flags.shorten or flags.shorten_thinking
246	            thinking = (
247	                truncate_middle(self.thinking, max_len=flags.shorten_width)
248	                if should_shorten_thinking
249	                else self.thinking
250	            )
251	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.THINKING, thinking))
252	
253	        # Tools
254	        if flags.show_tools and self.tools:
255	            self._append_tool_parts(parts, flags, tool_id_map)
256	
257	        # Plan (as tool-like part with name="ExitPlanMode")
258	        if flags.show_plans and self.plan:
259	            plan_content = (
260	                shorten_data(self.plan, width=flags.shorten_width)
261	                if flags.shorten
262	                else self.plan
263	            )
264	            plan_parts = ToolParts(
265	                tag=ContentBlockType.TOOL_INPUT.value.xml_tag,
266	                attrs=[("name", "ExitPlanMode")],
267	                content=plan_content,
268	                is_empty=False,
269	            )
270	            parts.append(MessagePart(MessagePartKind.TOOL, plan_parts))
271	
272	        return parts

43	class HighlightedMarkdown:
44	    """Render Markdown, then re-style substrings matching a regex (search hits).
45	
46	    Works on the rendered segment stream rather than reaching into Rich's
47	    Markdown internals, so the term highlight survives full markdown formatting
48	    and the renderable still wraps/sizes itself inside a Panel. Matches that fall
49	    within one rendered run — the common case for a search term — are
50	    highlighted; a term split across a style boundary is left untouched.
51	    """
52	
53	    def __init__(self, markup: str, regex: re.Pattern[str], style: str) -> None:
54	        self.markup = markup
55	        self.regex = regex
56	        self.style_name = style
57	
58	    def __rich_console__(
59	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
60	    ) -> RenderResult:
61	        highlight = console.get_style(self.style_name)
62	        for text, style, control in console.render(Markdown(self.markup), options):
63	            if control is not None or not text or not self.regex.search(text):
64	                yield Segment(text, style, control)
65	                continue
66	            cursor = 0
67	            for match in self.regex.finditer(text):
68	                if match.start() > cursor:
69	                    yield Segment(text[cursor : match.start()], style, control)
70	                combined = style + highlight if style else highlight
71	                yield Segment(match.group(), combined, control)
72	                cursor = match.end()
73	            if cursor < len(text):
74	                yield Segment(text[cursor:], style, control)
75

81	    return HighlightedMarkdown(markup, highlight_regex, "search.match")

84	class LeftRail:
85	    """Prefix every line of a renderable with a thin colored left rail (``▎``).
86	
87	    The rail's vertical span marks a tool block's extent without a horizontal
88	    rule (which is already the message/conversation separator). Renders the
89	    child at reduced width so the rail fits inside its enclosing Panel.
90	    """
91	
92	    def __init__(self, renderable, style: str, glyph: str = "▎ ") -> None:
93	        self.renderable = renderable
94	        self.style = style
95	        self.glyph = glyph
96	
97	    def __rich_console__(
98	        self, console: Console, options: ConsoleOptions
99	    ) -> RenderResult:
100	        rail = Segment(self.glyph, console.get_style(self.style))
101	        inner = options.update_width(max(1, options.max_width - len(self.glyph)))
102	        lines = console.render_lines(self.renderable, inner, pad=False)
103	
104	        is_blank = lambda line: all(not segment.text.strip() for segment in line)
105	        start, end = 0, len(lines)
106	        while start < end and is_blank(lines[start]):
107	            start += 1
108	        while end > start and is_blank(lines[end - 1]):
109	            end -= 1
110	
111	        for line in lines[start:end]:
112	            yield rail
113	            yield from line
114	            yield Segment.line()

148	def _strip_read_line_numbers(text: str) -> tuple[str, int]:
149	    """Strip Read's ``<n>\\t`` line-number gutter, returning (code, first_line)."""
150	    lines = text.split("\n")
151	    stripped: list[str] = []
152	    first: int | None = None
153	    matched = 0
154	    for line in lines:
155	        match = re.match(r"\s*(\d+)\t(.*)$", line)
156	        if match:
157	            matched += 1
158	            first = first if first is not None else int(match.group(1))
159	            stripped.append(match.group(2))
160	        else:
161	            stripped.append(line)
162	    if matched < max(1, len(lines) // 2):
163	        return text, 1
164	    return "\n".join(stripped), first or 1

356	def render_message_inner_xml(
357	    msg: Message, flags: ConversationFlags, tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None
358	) -> str:
359	    """Render message inner content (text, thinking, tools) to XML string.
360	
361	    Iterates msg.iter_visible_parts(flags), formats each part.
362	    Does NOT include outer wrapper tag or header.
363	    """
364	    output_parts: list[str] = []
365	    tool_parts: list[str] = []
366	
367	    def flush_tools() -> None:
368	        nonlocal tool_parts
369	        if tool_parts:
370	            output_parts.append("\n".join(tool_parts))
371	            tool_parts = []
372	
373	    for part in msg.iter_visible_parts(flags, tool_id_map):
374	        if part.kind == MessagePartKind.TEXT:
375	            flush_tools()
376	            output_parts.append(part.data)
377	
378	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.THINKING:
379	            flush_tools()
380	            tag = ContentBlockType.THINKING.value.xml_tag
381	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
382	
383	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.SUBAGENT_TASK:
384	            flush_tools()
385	            tag = ContentBlockType.SUBAGENT_TASK.value.xml_tag
386	            output_parts.append(f"<{tag}>\n{part.data}\n</{tag}>")
387	
388	        elif part.kind == MessagePartKind.TOOL:
389	            tool_parts.append(render_tool_xml(part.data))
390	
391	    flush_tools()
392	
393	    return "\n\n".join(output_parts)

396	def format_to_xml(
397	    messages: list[Message],
398	    flags: ConversationFlags,
399	    tool_id_map: dict[str, str] | None = None,
400	) -> str:
401	    """Format messages to XML-style tags."""
402	    output_parts = []
403	
404	    for msg in messages:
405	        content = render_message_inner_xml(msg, flags, tool_id_map)
406	        if not content:
407	            continue
408	
409	        # Strip trailing blank lines and single trailing space from last line
410	        content = content.rstrip("\n")
411	        lines = content.split("\n")
412	        if lines and lines[-1].endswith(" ") and not lines[-1].endswith("  "):
413	            lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
414	        content = "\n".join(lines)
415	
416	        wrapper_type = msg.get_wrapper_type()
417	        tag = wrapper_type.value.xml_tag
418	        header = msg.get_header()
419	        attrs = msg.get_wrapper_attrs()
420	
421	        if wrapper_type is ContentBlockType.AGENT:
422	            content = textwrap.indent(content, "  ")
423	
424	        output_parts.append(f"<{tag} {attrs}>\n{header}\n\n{content}\n</{tag}>")
425	
426	    return "\n\n---\n\n".join(output_parts)
